svg.text: Figure 5.8: E2's off count and literal step lengths
Off count · step 0 is the start
These are E2 replay scripts, not a runner trajectory. Certificate V and V⁻¹ were checked as SAFE-ALL words and applied as
composed actions; this is not evidence of twist-by-twist play of every step.
Committed research evidence · provisional colours · no Windows/DirectX or performance claim
